SELECT T.COST_TYPE, T.COST_DESC, SUM(T.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, T.DATE_SIGN, T.WEEK_START, T.WEEK_END, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T.WEEK_START DESC ) AS RK FROM (SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, CONCAT(year(AC.PAYMENT_TIME), 'WK', LPAD(WEEK(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1), 2, '0')) as DATE_SIGN, STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME ), '-', WEEK ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1 ), '-1' ), '%x-%v-%w' ) AS WEEK_START, DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME ), '-', WEEK ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1 ), '-1' ), '%x-%v-%w' ), INTERVAL 6 DAY ) AS WEEK_END, IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON ACUA.COST_ID = AC.ID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCostDto.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID = #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 WEEK), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 WEEK)) DAY) GROUP BY AC.ID,AC.COST_TYPE
UNION ALL
SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, CONCAT(year(AC.PAYMENT_TIME), 'WK', LPAD(WEEK(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1), 2, '0')) as DATE_SIGN, STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME ), '-', WEEK ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1 ), '-1' ), '%x-%v-%w' ) AS WEEK_START, DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME ), '-', WEEK ( AC.PAYMENT_TIME, 1 ), '-1' ), '%x-%v-%w' ), INTERVAL 6 DAY ) AS WEEK_END, IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON ACUA.COST_ID = AC.ID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCostDto.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID <> #{accountCostDto.userId} AND ACUA.USER_ID = #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 WEEK), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 WEEK)) DAY) GROUP BY AC.ID,AC.COST_TYPE) T GROUP BY T.COST_TYPE, T.DATE_SIGN ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC, OUTLAY DESC

SELECT T.COST_TYPE, T.COST_DESC, SUM(T.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY, T.DATE_SIGN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC ) AS RK FROM (SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%y%m') AS DATE_SIGN, IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON ACUA.COST_ID = AC.ID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCostDto.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID = #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY AC.ID,AC.COST_TYPE
UNION ALL
SELECT AC.COST_TYPE, AC.COST_DESC, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%y%m') AS DATE_SIGN, IF(ACUA.AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND ACUA.AMOUNT > 0, ACUA.AMOUNT, AC.OUTLAY) AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user_alloc ACUA ON ACUA.COST_ID = AC.ID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES'
AND AC.TENANT_ID = #{accountCostDto.tenantId}
AND AC.USER_ID <> #{accountCostDto.userId} AND ACUA.USER_ID = #{accountCostDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY AC.ID,AC.COST_TYPE) T GROUP BY T.COST_TYPE, T.DATE_SIGN ORDER BY T.DATE_SIGN DESC, OUTLAY DESC
